title: CEYO Transparency Log Inclusion Proof
description: A Merkle sibling-path proof that a specific artifact hash was included in the log at a given tree size and root. Produced by TransparencyLog.prove_inclusion() and verified by ceyo_verify.transparency.verify_inclusion_proof().

artifact_id.description: The artifact ID this proof is for.

artifact_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 hash of canonical(artifact_envelope). This is what is hashed to produce the Merkle leaf.

leaf_index.description: Zero-based index of this artifact's leaf in the Merkle tree.

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in the Merkle tree at the time this proof was generated.

root_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 Merkle root hash that the sibling path should reconstruct.

hashes.description: Ordered list of sibling hashes from the leaf level up to (but not including) the root. Each entry specifies the sibling's position relative to the current node at that level.

direction.description: 'right' means the sibling is to the right of the current node (current ‖ sibling); 'left' means to the left (sibling ‖ current).
